description.purpose: The fast lane: three predefined recipes rendered straight from their parameters into a manifest, with its sha256 digest. No model, no network, no disk -- what leaves here is a string built out of a dict.
description.use_when: Behind `classify` on hop.route == 'recipe', when the caller named a recipe and its parameters are complete.
description.not_in_scope: No inference, no retrieval, no application. And no rollback to lean on: the order of the declarations is semantics, because a manifest rolls forward and stops at the first refusal.
